verses.text: Ha honh tik yuninal honhxo Jehová ko Diosal. Manh kak' echnaj ko niwanil, manh ko joxpaxel xil ko jolom t'a snanhal ko sat ayik scham junok anima,
yujto schonhab' Jehová ko Diosal kaji. Ha ix honh sik'anel t'a skal juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a sat lu'um tik, yik tzonh ochkan yikok.
Manh he chi nok' nok' max chijilaj, nok' ay yowalil yuj Dios.
Haton nok' tik syal he chi'ani: Nok' wakax, nok' kalnel, nok' chiwa,
nok' ch'ukul, masanil makanhil nok' k'ultakil chej yet' nok' kaltakte'al chiwa.
Syal he chi'an masanil nok' nok' sjax yanh, cha xechanh yech.

Haxo pax nok' max yal-laj he chi'an jun, wach'chom sjax yanh nok' palta tato manh cha xechanhok yech nok', haton nok' tik: Nok' camello, nok' niwak chich yet' nok' tojolal chich. Ha juntzanh nok' tik manh wach'ok nok', sjax yanh nok', palta manh cha xechanhok yech nok'.
Yet' pax nok' chitam, cha xechanh yech nok', palta max sjaxlaj yanh nok'. Ha juntzanh nok' chi' yowalil tzeyojtakejeli to manh wach'ok nok'. Manh he chi nok', manh heyam nok' ayik chamnakxo nok'.
Haxo pax masanil nok' ay t'a yoltak ha ha', syal he chi'an nok' tato ay sk'axil nok' yet' stuminal spatik nok'.
Ha pax nok' malaj yik jun, manh he chi nok'. Yowalil tzeyojtakejeli to manh wach'ok nok'.
Ay pax nok' much syal he chi'ani, nok' wach' icha yalan ley.
Palta ay juntzanh nok' max yal-laj he chi'ani: Nok' ch'akb'a, nok' wakawok, nok' ch'akb'a yik ha ha',
nok' xulem, nok' milano,
yet' pax masanil makanhil nok' joj,
nok' avestruz, nok' niwak kujub', nok' xalunhe yet' masanil makanhil nok' ch'akb'a,
nok' tonton, nok' ibis yet' nok' pech,
nok' julum chay, nok' ostok, nok' kormorán,
nok' cigüeña, nok' abubilla yet' nok' sotz'.
Masanil nok' kotak nok' ay sk'axil tz'ek' t'a juntak petanhil, manh wach'ok nok'. Max yal-laj he chi'an nok'.
Haxo pax nok' kotak nok' to ay sk'axil alb'ilxo to wach', syal he chi'an nok'.

Manh he chi' junok nok' tonhej scham t'a ichnhejta', yujto ha honh tik sik'b'il honh el yuj Jehová ko Diosal. Palta syal heyak'an nok' t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a he kal. Ha heb' chi' syal schi'an nok' heb'. Mato syalpax he chonhan nok' t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il tonhej sb'eyek' t'a he kal. Manh he tz'anh nok' yune' chiwa t'a skal yal yim snun.
Junjun ab'il yowalil tzeyik'kanel sdiezmo'al sat heyawb'en yet' tastak tze mol sat.

Tzeyik'anb'at sdiezmo'al ixim he trigo, he wino yet' heyaceite. Tzeyik'anpaxb'at sb'ab'el yune' nok' he wakax yet' sb'ab'el yune' nok' he kalnel t'a jun lugar ol sik'el Jehová ko Diosal b'aj ol aj skajnub'. Hata' ol he wa juntzanh chi' t'a yichanh Jehová yuj heyik'ancha'anh.
Tato ha jun lugar b'aj ay skajnub' chi', najat skan t'ayex, tato niwan swach'k'olal Jehová syak' t'ayex, max yal heyik'anb'at masanil he diezmo chi',
syal he chonhaneli, haxo stojol tzeyik'b'at t'a skajnub' Jehová chi'.

Haxo yet' stojol chi' syal he manan tas syal he k'o'ol: Nok' wakax, nok' kalnel, wino, ma tas tz'uk'ji to pajxo, ma juntzanhxo tas tze nib'ej, tzex wa t'a tzalajk'olal yet' heyal heyuninal t'a yichanh Jehová.
Ha heb' levita kajan t'a he kal, tzeyawtej heb' wa'el heyet'ok, yujto manh ol yik'laj slu'um heb' smakb'enok icha heyik ha hex tik.
Ha slajwi junjun yoxil ab'il tzeyik'ankanel sdiezmo'al sat heyawb'en yet' tas tze mol t'a jun ab'il chi'. Tze molb'ej t'a junok lugar t'a yol he chonhab' chi'.

Ha heb' levita to maj schalaj slu'um smakb'enok heyet'ok, ma heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a he kal, ma heb' meb'a' manhxa smam yet' heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum, syal swa'an heb' tastak tze mol t'a he diezmo chi', tz'akan slaj yik' yik heb'. Tato icha chi' tze k'ulej, ol yak' swach'k'olal Jehová ko Diosal t'a yib'anh masanil tastak tze k'ulej.
